data.title: 长离 · 荷池边的海滨茶席
data.description: 【今州海湾荷池·午后】长离穿着桃红色泳装外搭轻便长衫，斜坐在水边木台给自己斟一杯冷茶；荷叶与海风同时掠过她的长发，她抬眼向镜头举杯，笑意从授课时的端庄变得轻盈。
data.action: 荷池海湾木台边斟冷茶举杯，海风吹动长发与桃红外衫
data.lighting: warm afternoon light across water and lotus leaves
data.mood: 长离难得只教自己休息
data.promptProse: Changli from Wuthering Waves wears a peach-red swimsuit with a cream long overshirt, embroidered sash and a glass of chilled tea. She sits at the edge of the coastal lotus pool and pours chilled tea into a small glass. Sea wind moves the peach fabric and long pink hair together; she raises the drink toward the viewer with the lighter smile of a teacher finally taking her own break. warm afternoon light across water and lotus leaves.
